text:
alex: Heads up — PR #4821 is ready for security review. It adds a small auth change and a new env var-based onprem secret path support. Please look for secrets-in-fs risk and VPC/egress implications. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

lina: pinging @eng-security for a quick look. Main items: REDWOOD_ONPREM_SECRET_PATH, sidecar mount, and fallback to KMS when path missing. Also wondering about how this behaves during autoscale.

raj: quick skim + 2 cents: code style ok. Major ask: ensure we never log the raw path or secret. Also need a short threat model for the sidecar mount — enumerate who can read the FS and how we mitigate. Please add to PR description.

maria: @alex can you add a unit/integration test that simulates missing path -> KMS fallback? Shows expected failure modes. Also add explicit vault path allowlist instead of arbitrary paths.

sec-bot: Security checklist reminder:
- KMS encryption at rest confirmed
- No secrets printed in logs (grep for REDWOOD_ONPREM_SECRET_PATH)
- Service account least-privilege for sidecar mount
- Egress rules: onprem sidecar must not call out to third-party endpoints
- Add rotation policy note to PR

oliver: I can take a deeper look tonight. If we get 2 approvals can we merge tomorrow morning after a quick staging smoke test? Prefer merge window 09:00 PST to avoid late-night rollbacks.

alex: thanks — updated the PR: added threat model section, unit test for missing path -> KMS, and clarified KMS config. Removed a debug log that echoed env vars. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 (updated)

lina: small nit: remove the remaining echo in the auth handler where it logs path for debugging. Also add an allowlist check in config parsing: only approved base paths allowed.

raj: If alex addresses the nit and adds a note about rotation cadence (30 days?), I can approve. Right now request_changes until those are in.

oliver: LGTM pending the log removal. If alex confirms, I can approve and then merge Tue 09:00 PST after a quick staging smoke and deploy-bot run.

alex: I removed the log echo, added env allowlist and rotation note (30d) to the PR. Marking ready for review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — re-running a quick local smoke, no obvious leaks. Approving from my side.

raj: approving now.

oliver: approved. I'll merge Tue 09:00 PST unless anyone raises a blocker before then.

alex: appreciated. I'll watch staging after merge and post an incident ping if anything flakey.

sec-bot: Note: post-merge action item: run secrets-scan for release artifacts and add to deploy checklist.
